summary.name: Conduit
summary.one_liner: Conduit is a lightweight, open-source Matrix homeserver written in Rust, focused on easy setup and low system requirements.
use_cases: Hosting a private Matrix chat server for a community
Running a lightweight homeserver on low-resource hardware
Replacing a heavier Matrix server like Synapse
Bridging a Matrix server to outside chat networks such as Discord
Quickly setting up a personal decentralized chat server
summary.what_it_does: Conduit is a server implementation of the Matrix Specification, the open protocol for decentralized, federated chat. It is distributed as a single binary with an embedded RocksDB database by default, which the page says keeps setup simple. The project aims for easy installation and low system requirements, and claims it can be much faster than other server implementations in some cases. Users on a Conduit server can chat with users on other Matrix servers, and bridges can connect to outside networks like Discord.
notable: Single binary with embedded RocksDB database
Written in Rust and licensed Apache-2.0
Positioned as a lightweight alternative to Synapse
Focus on easy setup and low system requirements
caveats: Project is in beta and missing some smaller features
